}}'''Keatlin''' is a [[novice]] in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Keatlin|Keatlin}} Her potential strength is 

==Strength and Abilities==
Keatlin is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] potential of {{opsl|31}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.{{ref||Keatlin}} 

Since she has only been channeling less than a year, she is a long way from reaching her potential.

==History==
She was born in {{ne|973}} in Altara.{{ref||Keatlin}}

== Activities ==
She was recruited by the Rebels in Altara.

She complains about [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] teaching her class; being older than Nynaeve, she didn't like being ordered around by her or Elayne.
